reference.title: Document Information
reference.shortdesc: Documentation by Karan Deshmukh of the KC1 prediction API, version 1.0.0, from the Group 6 MSc project at ESAIP. Every request and response in it was recorded from the API on 19 November 2026, against the model that the project’s trainer produced.
